title: Create a service storefront
description: Present Agent Card capabilities as a human-readable service page without coupling UI to runtime internals.
icon: Store

The Next.js and TanStack UI adapters generate a **service storefront**. It
renders public identity, health, capability schemas, operation URLs, and payment
requirements from HTTP contracts.

Generate one with:

```bash
bunx @lucid-agents/cli my-service --adapter=tanstack-ui
# or
bunx @lucid-agents/cli my-service --adapter=next
```

Storefront components consume `buildServicePageModel()` from
`@lucid-agents/http`. They must not inspect `runtime.entrypoints`, payments
internals, or adapter-specific registries. This keeps the UI truthful across
frameworks and lets headless deployments expose the same service contract.

The storefront is not an operations dashboard. Payment reconciliation,
analytics, alerts, and task administration belong to your production tooling.
